intro.text: A religious school of the Emerald Sea where students train to become preachers.

description.text: Students learn to lead their congregations in honouring the moons and in reflecting on the purpose of life.
There are many moonschools, and their preachers rarely agree on what life's purpose is; even two from the same school may differ.
Preachers put their training to use above all on Moonday, preaching reverence for the moons and their own view of life's meaning.
